name: Helius Solana RPC (via pay.sh)
description: Pay-per-call Solana RPC access via Helius, routed through the pay.sh x402 proxy launched by Solana Foundation + Google Cloud. Demonstrates gavel_toolkit's ability to dispatch through a registry-of-registries.
_note: When resolve_and_call gains pay.sh routing support, providers with via=pay.sh will be dispatched through the pay.sh proxy with the underlying provider name resolved by pay.sh's catalog.
